nodes.author: NandiniM2000
nodes.text:
2/ From Dec 16-22, 2024:

Respiratory infections spiked in China.

HMPV was behind 6% of positive cases.

It caused 5.4% of respiratory-related hospitalizations.

Doesn’t that sound huge? Think again.

@MirrorReview1 #hmpvvirus #Disease

nodes.author: NandiniM2000
nodes.text:
3/ Here’s why it’s serious:

Kids under 14 are hit the hardest.

Globally, HMPV causes 5-15% of respiratory illnesses in hospitalized babies.

That means 1 in 6 sick babies with breathing issues could have this virus.

#HealthForAll #clean #Respiratory

nodes.author: NandiniM2000
nodes.text:
4/ It’s not just a cold.

HMPV can lead to:

Bronchitis
Pneumonia
In severe cases, the a need for oxygen or ventilators.
This virus has been around for decades, but most people don’t know about it.

#Bronchitis #pneumonia #oxygen #ventilators

nodes.author: NandiniM2000
nodes.text:
5/ Why now?

Experts say winter is to blame. 

Viruses love cold weather. 

But could the virus be evolving? 

And is China giving us the full picture?

This all feels too familiar—anyone else reminded of early COVID-19?

#Covid_19

nodes.author: NandiniM2000
nodes.text:
6/ What we know so far:

No vaccine.

No specific treatment—only symptom management.

Kids under 14 are most affected.

Even with decades of research, HMPV is still a mystery.

#vaccine

nodes.author: NandiniM2000
nodes.text:
7/ The lesson from COVID-19? 

Stay alert. 

Even small spikes can turn into big problems if ignored.

What do you think? 

Seasonal virus or something bigger? 

Let’s discuss it!
